newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin closes up on short-covering.
newsitem.headline: KL tin closes up on short-covering.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price rose 16 cents to 14.51 ringgit ($5.85) a kg in tandem with overnight gains on the London Metal Exchange (LME), traders said.
"There was some covering at the lower levels and this pushed the market up," said a trader. The LME rose $20 on Monday.
Traders said initial bids outnumbered offers by 111 tonnes to 70. Buyers were Europeans and locals and turnover was at 96 tonnes, the same as Wednesday.
The local premium against London widened to $170 from $125.
